prompt: Original refined medieval fantasy tactical RPG pixel art, inspired mainly by Warcraft Orc character and Tolkien grounded functional materials. Adult male Orc agile armored veteran, lean athletic muscular anatomy, long legs, defined narrow waist, flat abdomen, angular shoulders, strong sinewy arms. Not fat, bloated, squat or bodybuilder bulky. Bald head, hard angular face, restrained tusks, olive grey skin. Imposing but mobile fitted articulated dark iron armor: shaped cuirass tapering to waist, compact layered pauldrons, flexible chainmail joints, short split hip tassets, fitted bracers, segmented knee guards, practical narrow boots. Clearly detailed rivets, bevels, scratches and leather straps. Restrained charcoal iron and worn brown leather palette, muted olive skin, tiny dull steel highlights, no bright red orange yellow or decorative gold. Weight looks distributed for quick footwork. Empty hands relaxed beside body. Full body standing front three-quarter facing down-right, both complete boots visible, 128x128 transparent canvas with margins, crisp pixel clusters, rich controlled material shading. No weapon held carried or sheathed, no shield, no scenery, no text.
